reason: Free Wi-Fi, 70 seats and open till midnight is just what I need to study after the 7th Circle traffic, so I'd go in and sit for hours on one Americano. On my budget it's maybe once a week, though, and I'd never order it on Talabat with delivery fees on top.
objection: 3 to 3.50 dinars for a latte is a lot when I make about 250 a month, and I don't know if there are plugs or if they'll mind me sitting all afternoon on one drink.
would_change_my_mind: A student discount or a cheap refill for people who stay a few hours, plus knowing there are plugs at the tables, would get me in two or three times a week.
